page.overview:
Who is Rivers?

Rivers is the gunner of the former Bellamy Pirates.

Rivers is a tall man with a good physique. He wears a white hat with long ear-flaps, a dark-red V-neck shirt with grey trousers and brown boots.

When he was younger he wore a white cap very similar to the one he would have as an adult and a blue shirt with green spots and white pants.

He feels that Bellamy shouldn't get his hands dirty like people like Luffy, Zoro, and Nami, whom he doesn't consider to be on his level. After Bellamy's defeat, Rivers showed his cowardice, to the point of preventing Sarquiss from facing Luffy and, like the rest, doing nothing when Luffy took all of his captain's gold.
